scope: Native macOS ARM64 test-only fixtures. No product configuration or inherited environment feature is added. No new GoF/EIP product relationship is claimed.
sourceReview: Main and peer read all four complete Go files. Relay forwards bytes unchanged to one separately pinned genuine upstream endpoint, with no API parsing, synthetic responses or payload logging. It bounds connections and bytes, owns each original stream and joins its copy workers. Permission stimulus changes only a held private gate and retains the listener; unavailable stimulus closes/joins the listener, verifies the exact stale socket before unlink, and binds a new owned inode. Cleanup restores access before the Docker fixture uses the proxy. Unknown joins remain failures, never successful cleanup. Existing runtime owner proofs, refusal deadlines, exact diagnostics, leases and same-data recovery assertions remain required.

nativeControls.scope: Compiled the complete native launcher package with exactly these four additions. Exercised transparent byte copying, caps, cancellation, close failures, pause/resume state, required original session joins and socket identity comparisons. No selected control constructed a listener, used a socket or contacted an engine. This is not live proxy, permission or unavailable-engine evidence.

preparationReviewFinding: Peer found whole-stat comparison includes atime and can reject its own read. A separate preparer revision must compare only stable metadata, require a single link and preserve checked-close errors before any account-visible context or live fixture preparation. The four Go sources are unchanged by that separate correction.

reviewedPreparerCorrection.interpreterRequirement: Use the prepared Python 3.14 runtime; BaseExceptionGroup is not available in the system Python 3.9.
reviewedPreparerCorrection.review: Main read the full reader delta and all controls; peer independently reviewed it. Stable identity/access/content metadata excludes atime, requires a single link, bounds reads and checks the original descriptor's sole close. Both exact primary and close exceptions survive a combined failure. Controls extract and execute the actual reader AST with a fake OS, not real selection I/O or the preparer entry.

independentSourceAndControlAudit.scope: Peer checked all four promoted Go hashes, the full native ten-test raw result, before/after source maps including exactly four declared additions, unchanged tools, and all ten actual-AST reader controls. All 352 original build-map source hashes remain unchanged. No live query, context or engine action by reviewer.

reviewedLiveRunner.review: Main and peer read the complete runner. It permits exactly the 352 unchanged installed-build sources plus the four fixed test additions, checks all source/tool/artifact pins and derived inputs, and binds a unique account-visible context to only the private selected endpoint. No DOCKER_CONFIG/HOST/CONTEXT overrides or default-context change command. One original context-create command must join successfully before one anchored Go test. One exclusive execution marker prevents replay. Actual-AST controls cover structural binding and seven finalization cancellation/I/O cases; they do not replace the unchanged capture core's hash-verifier controls.

firstActualPermissionFailure.scope: Actual positive installed cold startup and preserved-data check passed through the genuine proxy. Exact owned runtime quiescence preceded the proxy failure. The original error did not export per-stream stages; it cannot establish whether normal disconnect semantics, a limit or unjoined work caused the refusal. Fixture/context/captures are retained, not reset or adopted. No EACCES or corrected-recovery pass is claimed.

diagnosticOnlyRepair.review: Main and peer reviewed fixed copy_io/half_close stage fields, bounded numeric errno through exact standard wrappers only, and a mutex-protected copy of published results with separate registered/joined counts. No live payload/output buffer is read, arbitrary error text is never called, and failure/refusal/cleanup requirements are unchanged. Added controls cover hostile/cyclic errno wrappers, closed state stages and independent result-copy/join observations.
diagnosticOnlyRepair.remaining: Actual private Unix stream close controls must establish native errno and order before any change to accepted close behavior. Do not ignore arbitrary network failures or rerun the full stack merely to guess.

nativeCloseRepair.review: Only genuine owned Unix streams with nil copy completion and the exact native shutdown ENOTCONN wrapper admit peer disconnection. Synthetic ENOTCONN, EPIPE, locally closed streams and unknown failures still fail. Both original copy workers and checked closes remain required.
nativeCloseRepair.limit: Later ordinary Unix controls establish their own behavior, not the missing historical cause of the first failed full-stack run.

finiteBudgetRepair.observation: The old fixture rejected accept513 after512 registered sessions. All512 published sessions joined without individual stream or close failure. Final counts establish exhaustion, not the exact time of the first failed refresh.
finiteBudgetRepair.review: Explicit finite fixture headroom, not a measured worst-case guarantee. Accept4097 still refuses before registration. No counter reset, unlimited fallback or product connection setting.

currentActualCases.cleanup: Both exact owned broker containers stopped and retained with their data volumes. Only their verified empty owned networks were removed; unrelated network baselines stayed unchanged.
